create_crr_config_with_defaults: create a CRRConfig instance using all default values for learning rate, discount, and target update period
create_crr_config_custom_learning_rate: create a CRRConfig with a custom learning rate of 1e-3 for faster convergence
create_crr_config_custom_discount: create a CRRConfig with a discount factor of 0.95 for shorter horizon TD updates
create_crr_config_sarsa_target: create a CRRConfig with use_sarsa_target set to True for on-policy 1-step offline RL
create_crr_config_custom_update_period: create a CRRConfig with a target_update_period of 50 for more frequent target network updates
